{"slug": "colophon", "type": "section", "title": "How this page works", "summary": "how this page works", "order": "0", "display": "details", "body": "This HTML is twenty-two lines plus one small script, and until you click something no library at all; everything else on the page is a Nostr event signed by this site's key and rendered in place. The page is pre-rendered from [my relay](https://relay.ronishbhatt.com) at deploy, then your browser asks the relay again and rebuilds itself only if something changed, so edits appear live in every open tab. The blocks travel veiled (NIP-44 under a key that lives in this page, with hashed identifiers), so relays and Nostr clients see noise while anyone holding the page can read them; the chat is NIP-17 (NIP-59 gift wraps, NIP-44 encryption, NIP-13 proof of work), and the icon is the first sixteen hex digits of the signing key, one shade of green per digit."}
